mapper.select: SELECT s.stat_id, s.etf_id, s.view_count, s.updated_at, p.etf_name FROM etf_statistics s JOIN etf_product p ON p.etf_id = s.etf_id WHERE s.updated_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) ORDER BY s.view_count DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT s.stat_id, s.etf_id, s.view_count, s.updated_at, p.etf_name FROM etf_statistics s JOIN etf_product p ON p.etf_id = s.etf_id WHERE s.updated_at >= CURDATE() ORDER BY s.view_count DESC LIMIT 10
